# v1.1.0 — Blueprint detail levels: hand "how deep it understands your project" to the user

> **zread-pi 1.1.0**: blueprint generation gains five `blueprint.detail` levels (minimal / low / medium / high / max,
> default `high` = zero behavior change). Quantity control is handled by a four-layer mechanism —
> "prompt-level targets + standing quantity feedback + AI merge + condensing agent / code fallback":
> out-of-range results are never silently truncated, and generation never hangs when the model fails to converge.

## ✨ New capabilities

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| **Five detail levels** | `minimal` (1 section · 1 panorama article, must include a Mermaid architecture diagram) → `low` (3–5 sections · 1–3 articles each, skips title refinement) → `medium` (4–6 · 3–5) → `high` (4–8 · 3–10, default) → `max` (4–8 · 5–12, emphasizing comprehensive coverage and deep file exploration) |
| **Standing quantity feedback** | Every `submit_sections` / `submit_section_topics` response includes "currently N / required min–max (current level)" — even within range; the model self-calibrates at zero extra cost |
| **AI merge as the main path** | Out-of-range submissions are not persisted and don't error; instead a merge / supplement strategy text is returned for re-submission; at most 2 rounds |
| **Condensing subagent** | If the original conversation fails to converge twice, a small agent with a clean context is spawned (overridden systemPrompt + small budget + one-shot read-only output tool) that looks only at the manifest to break self-anchoring; its result still merges through the normal persistence path (file lock + single numbering point), silently degrading on failure |
| **Deterministic code fallback** | Base sections keep order and take the first N; one article per distinct group, then fill in order; results are annotated "adjustment round limit reached, finalized by code" — generation never hangs |
| **CLI `/config/detail`** | pi-tui five-level selector page (Enter applies / s saves), config key `blueprint.detail`; old config.yaml files without the section are auto-filled with `high` |

## 🔧 Behavior differences (intentional)

- Out-of-range results are no longer silently truncated (the old `slice(0, 8)`); quantity **minimums** are enforced too (except sync: existing sections / pages are always kept, only the max is checked).
- `low` / `minimal` skip the title-refinement stage; `minimal` skips "base-section backfill", keeps only "Overview",
  and appends a "panorama article" requirement to the page prompt (a Mermaid architecture diagram mapping modules and data flow).
- New tool names `submit_condensed_sections` / `submit_condensed_topics` (used only by the condensing agent, one-shot read-only).

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.1.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli config     # /config/detail to pick a blueprint detail level
bun run cli
```

## ✅ Verification

`bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` (all 13 suites green), and `bun run mock:wiki` (`completed=5 failed=0`) were all actually executed;
blueprint-detail specifics: `test:blueprint` `blueprint-detail.ts` 83/83, `e2e-blueprint` 29/29,
`test:pages` 19/19 (minimal panorama propagation), `test:tui` smoke-tui 225 assertions.

# v1.1.0 —— 蓝图细节档位：把「项目理解深度」交给用户

> **zread-pi 1.1.0**：蓝图生成新增 `blueprint.detail` 五档（minimal / low / medium / high / max，
> 默认 `high` = 旧行为零变化）。数量控制由「提示词数量目标 + 常驻数量反馈 + AI 归并 +
> 缩编 Agent / 代码兜底」四层机制承担：再也不会越界静默截断，也不会因为模型不收敛而悬挂。

## ✨ 新能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **五档细节** | `minimal`（1 个分类 · 1 篇全景导览，必须 Mermaid 架构图）→ `low`（3~5 分类 · 每分类 1~3 篇，跳过标题精修）→ `medium`（4~6 · 3~5）→ `high`（4~8 · 3~10，默认）→ `max`（4~8 · 5~12，强调全面详尽、深挖关联文件） |
| **常驻数量反馈** | `submit_sections` / `submit_section_topics` 每次返回都带「当前 N / 要求 min~max（当前档位）」，区间内也发；模型随时自我校准，零额外成本 |
| **AI 归并主路径** | 越界提交不落盘、不报错，返回归并 / 补充策略文本请求重提；最多 2 轮 |
| **缩编 subagent** | 原对话两次不收敛后，开一个干净上下文的小 Agent（覆盖 systemPrompt + 小预算 + 一次性只读输出工具），只看清单本身打破自我锚定；结果仍走 merge 落盘（文件锁与编号单点），失败静默降级 |
| **代码确定性兜底** | 基础分类保序取前 N / 每 distinct group 保 1 篇再按序填充；结果注记「已达到调整轮次上限，代码侧收尾」，生成永不悬挂 |
| **CLI `/config/detail`** | pi-tui 五档选择页（Enter 应用 / s 保存），配置项 `blueprint.detail`；旧 config.yaml 缺段自动补 `high` |

## 🔧 行为差异（有意为之）

- 越界不再静默截断（旧实现 `slice(0, 8)`）；数量**下限**也生效（sync 除外：既有分类 / 页面必留，只校验上限）。
- `low` / `minimal` 跳过标题精修阶段；`minimal` 跳出「基础分类强补」，只保留「概览」，
  并给页面提示词附加「全景导览」要求（Mermaid 架构图梳理模块关系与数据流）。
- 新增工具名 `submit_condensed_sections` / `submit_condensed_topics`（仅缩编 Agent 使用，一次性只读）。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.1.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli config     # /config/detail 选择蓝图细节档位
bun run cli
```

`bun run typecheck`、`bun run test`（13 个套件全绿）、`bun run mock:wiki`（`completed=5 failed=0`）均已实际执行；
蓝图细节档位专项：`test:blueprint` 的 `blueprint-detail.ts` 83/83、`e2e-blueprint` 29/29，
